data.title: Speeding fine (Bußgeldbescheid) – €98.50, 1 point
data.summary: The City of Musterau fines authority (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 2 September 2026. The total is €98.50 plus 1 point in the driving-fitness register (Fahreignungsregister). It was formally delivered on 17 September 2026.
data.explanation: You are accused of exceeding the 70 km/h limit by 23 km/h outside built-up areas. The fine is €70.00 plus €25.00 fees and €3.50 expenses. You can either accept it or file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fines authority; the app shows the objection deadline. If you do not object in time, the notice becomes final and enforceable, and you must pay within two weeks after that. An objection can also lead to a less favourable decision. If unsure, consider legal advice.

items.title: File objection against fine notice

date.text: innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record with the Stadt Musterau fines authority.
items.consequence: Otherwise the notice becomes final and enforceable; an objection may also lead to a less favourable decision.
items.quote: Dieser Bußgeldbescheid wird rechtskräftig und vollstreckbar, wenn Sie nicht innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der oben bezeichneten Verwaltungsbehörde Einspruch einlegen.

items.title: Pay fine of €98.50
items.action: Pay the total to the authority's account, quoting the file number, within two weeks after the notice becomes final.
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
